name: Dallas Morning News editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Dallas Morning News Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/dallas-morning-news-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Dallas
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that says it is 'part of a nonpartisan political organization operating at the local, state, and national level' (https://lwvdallas.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Dallas County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its November page lists the Democrats on the ballot (a nominee roster, not a separate endorsement vote).

name: Dallas County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its Meet the Candidates page lists Republican nominees but states "These are not endorsements."

name: North Texas Area Labor Federation (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO federation that describes itself as 'a unified regional body bringing together all affiliated unions across the area' (https://northtxlabor.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Stonewall Democrats of Dallas
lean_basis: Its stated mission or political identity includes: "Champion the Democratic Party's commitment to justice, equity, and foster LGBTQ+ engagement.". Source: https://www.stonewalldemocratsofdallas.org/.

name: Dallas Regional Chamber
lean_basis: Regional chamber of commerce that says it is 'the voice of business in the Dallas Region' (https://www.dallaschamber.org/about/), advocating pro-growth policies. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Dallas Police Association
lean_basis: Police union that says 'The sole purpose of the DPA is to represent Dallas Police Officers in matters relating to employment, benefits and general well-being' (https://dallaspa.org/about/who-we-are). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
